We went to a clinic to have a wound cleaned for 300฿. This was the first clinic where the service from the staff was so bad.
Not even a greeting was given.
The staff at the counter sat playing on their phones from the moment we entered until we left. They did work, but they did it quickly and then rushed back to playing on their phones.
If I had no choice but to go there again, I'd regret paying 10฿ for it.
From the initial inquiry to the wound dressing, I greeted them when I entered the clinic, but there was no response or sign of welcome from anyone working there. Don't even think about a smile. The woman at the counter barely looked up from her phone to see the patients.
Seeing that, I sat down to wait.
(There were a total of 4 nurses and staff in the clinic, each seated at their assigned spot.)
After a while, the woman at the reception desk spoke loudly and abruptly, without any politeness or intonation. “What’s wrong?” *I got up and walked over to answer her.* She then asked about my weight, etc., and after finishing, said,
“Go sit and wait to be called.”
I sat for a while and then was called to pay.
I didn't have to wait long before they called me in to have my wound treated. The treatment was quick, without any regard for the patient. They rushed through the process, just to get it over with. They put on a very large gauze pad, almost reaching my genitals, making it difficult to use the restroom. Even a light urination soiled the gauze. I had to buy replacement supplies myself, even though the wound was on the upper thigh, far from my genitals.
When I left, I went to the counter to ask for my receipt, but the woman at the checkout counter was still playing on her phone.
I saw her place something on the counter, and I assumed it was the receipt. No one said or told me that it was my receipt; I had to open it myself to see which one had my name on it. Even after I picked up the documents and receipt from the counter, she continued playing on her phone without even looking up.

A clinic with such a good location should have many patients wanting to use its services, but it's a shame that with staff who are constantly on their phones and lack a passion for service, there won't be any positive reviews from patients.
